description: This file defines the CacheUtils utility class for cache management operations, including storing, retrieving, and removing cache entries, as well as fetching cache keys associated with a merchant store.

classes.name: CacheUtils
classes.description: A utility class for cache operations such as adding, retrieving, and removing cache entries, and fetching cache keys for a merchant store.

methods.name: putInCache
methods.description: Stores an object in the cache with a specified key.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the cache by key.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of cache keys associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: shutDownCache
methods.description: Placeholder method for shutting down cache, currently does nothing.

methods.name: removeFromCache
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry identified by key.

methods.name: removeAllFromCache
methods.description: Removes all cache entries related to a specific merchant store.
